messages.text: ok I've been thinking about this all day. what if we actually did japan in the spring
wait seriously
seriously. flights are weirdly cheap right now and I have the vacation days banked
ok I'm in. how long are we thinking
two weeks? tokyo, kyoto, maybe a couple days somewhere quiet
let's do it
booked the flights!! we leave march 14 and come back the 28th
oh my god it's real
$1,180 each, which honestly for those dates is a steal
you are extremely good at this
so for the quiet few days — I found a ryokan and I think it's the one
show me
we booked the Hoshinoya in Kyoto for the third night, the one with the private onsen looking over the river
that looks unreal
it was the splurge of the whole trip and I regret nothing
hey do we need to sort out the rail pass before we go or can we do it there
before. I'll order them this week, they mail you a voucher
amazing thank you
you did tokyo two years ago right. give me your list
oh I have been WAITING for this
you have to get the black cod at Nobu, it genuinely rearranged my brain chemistry
noted
book it early though, they fill up like a month out
oh also — skip the conveyor belt spot everyone posts about near the station, it's a tourist trap and I'm still bitter
lol noted, avoiding
protecting you from my own mistakes 😤
we are ON THE PLANE. 14 hours. see you on the other side of the international date line
godspeed
ok that kaiseki dinner tonight was 280 a head which is by a mile the most we have ever spent on a single meal
worth every yen and I will not be taking questions
no argument here. fourteen courses
the one with the persimmon. I'm still thinking about the one with the persimmon
the onsen at the ryokan at 6am with the mist coming off the water might be the best thing I've ever done
genuinely peak human experience
maya was right about the black cod by the way. she was so right
I'm texting her immediately
